availability_limits: Literal historical organizations, not verified contemporary starting rosters or identity alias resolution.
2024+ is a game-era proxy; native source-calendar days and retrospectively collected provider state clocks are not certified publication timestamps.
Valve Git first-addition commit clock plus seven-day lag is conservative provenance, not independent proof of public release.
Historical benchmark does not establish access to limits, prices, bets or settlement at those clocks.
Development-only model selection after a known previous TEST failure; no new independent bookmaker confirmation.
Latent common map strength is an exchangeability approximation, not an actual map/veto or prematch-roster model.
Gaussian day-site approximation omits posterior team covariance and does not certify calibrated probability intervals.
